metadata.purpose: Question-to-field mapping for Cosmos DB ingestion. At ingestion, look up each raw question → get canonical_id → store response under that ID.
metadata.usage: For each survey response: (1) find raw_question in question_mapping, (2) get canonical_id, (3) store value under that canonical_id in the site profile. Unmapped questions stored as raw for manual harmonization later.
metadata.ingestion_rule: Per-field most-recent: each canonical field independently keeps its most recent value across all surveys. A newer survey that does not ask a question does NOT erase the older answer.
